de.meta_title: Essen & Trinken in Eppan, St. Pauls & Girlan | Hotel Weinberg
de.meta_description: Restaurant-Tipps rund um St. Pauls, Eppan und Girlan: Pizza, Südtiroler Küche und Aperitivo – ausgewählt von Familie Schrott vom Hotel Weinberg.
de.hero_heading: Wo man rund um St. Pauls & Eppan gut isst
de.hero_text: Wir kochen nicht mehr selbst, verraten euch aber gern, wohin wir zum Essen gehen: von der Pizza um die Ecke bis zum Aperitivo im historischen Ansitz.

polaroids.alt: Cocktail mit Beeren-Garnitur in der Abendsonne
polaroids.caption: Aperitivo-Stunde

cards.name: Paulserhof
cards.desc: Traditionsgasthaus mit 700 Jahre altem Weinkeller mitten im Dorf, Südtiroler Klassiker mit mediterraner Note, seit über 60 Jahren beliebter Treffpunkt.
cards.hours: Ganzjährig geöffnet · Reservierung empfohlen

cards.name: Allegra
cards.desc: Mediterraner Flair trifft Südtiroler Tradition im historischen Ansitz, perfekt für Aperitif, feine Weine und saisonale Küche im idyllischen Innenhof.

cards.img_alt: Liliane Pizzeria Café Eisdiele, St. Pauls
cards.name: Liliane
cards.desc: Pizza aus dem Steinofen, hausgemachtes Eis und Café hinter mittelalterlichen Mauern, locker, familienfreundlich, auch Dinkel- und glutenfreie Pizza.
cards.hours: Do–So bis 23:30 Uhr, Mo–Mi bis 24:00 Uhr · Pizza ab 17 Uhr

cards.name: Pfeffermühle
cards.desc: Der Treffpunkt für Genießer bei Bozen: Tatar-Klassiker und moderne Südtiroler Küche treffen auf Pizza aus dem Holzofen, umgeben von Obstgärten.
cards.hours: 11:45–14:00 & 18:00–21:30 Uhr · Mi ganztägig & Do mittags geschlossen

cards.name: Platzegg
cards.desc: „Ehrlich, einfach, echt": Herbert Hintner macht Südtiroler Klassiker und fast vergessene Regionalgerichte auf der Piazza von St. Michael wieder restaurantfein.
cards.hours: Mo, Do–Sa 12–14 & 18:30–21 Uhr · Mi 18:30–21 Uhr · So 12–14 Uhr · Di Ruhetag

cards.name: Meraner (Talele)
cards.desc: Pizza aus dem Holzofen, Grillklassiker und Südtiroler Küche in dritter Generation Familientradition, überdachte Terrasse ideal für Aperitif und laue Abende.
cards.hours: Di–Sa 17–23 Uhr · So Pizza 17–21 Uhr · Mo Ruhetag · Sommer mittags geschlossen

cards.name: Wiesenheim
cards.desc: Mediterrane Küche mit Südtiroler Spezialitäten und Pizza aus dem Holzofen, in ruhiger Lage Richtung Frangart, gern besucht von Einheimischen.
cards.hours: 12:00–14:00 & 17:30–21:15 Uhr (Pizza bis 22 Uhr) · So mittags nur Pizza · Do Ruhetag

cards.name: The Grillhouse, Golfclub Eppan
cards.desc: Mediterrane Küche und saftige Steaks vom Holzkohlegrill direkt am Golfplatz, Show-Küche, Pizza aus dem Steinofen und große Weinauswahl in lockerer Atmosphäre.
cards.hours: Restaurant Di–Sa 12–15 & 19–23 Uhr · Pizza Di–Sa 17–23, So 17–21 Uhr

it.meta_title: Mangiare e bere ad Appiano e dintorni | Hotel Weinberg
it.meta_description: Ristoranti consigliati tra San Paolo, Appiano e Cornaiano: pizza, cucina altoatesina e aperitivo – scelti dalla famiglia Schrott dell'Hotel Weinberg.
it.hero_heading: Dove si mangia bene tra St. Paolo & Appiano
it.hero_text: Non cuciniamo più noi, ma vi sveliamo volentieri dove andiamo a mangiare: dalla pizza dietro l'angolo all'aperitivo in un antico ansitz.

polaroids.alt: Cocktail guarnito con frutti di bosco al tramonto
polaroids.caption: L'ora dell'aperitivo

polaroids.alt: Canederli altoatesini con arrosto di manzo
polaroids.caption: Gusto deciso & regionale

cards.name: Paulserhof
cards.desc: Locanda tradizionale con cantina di 700 anni nel cuore del paese, classici altoatesini con un tocco mediterraneo, punto d'incontro amato da oltre 60 anni.
cards.hours: Aperto tutto l'anno · Prenotazione consigliata

cards.name: Allegra
cards.desc: Atmosfera mediterranea incontra la tradizione altoatesina in uno storico ansitz, perfetto per aperitivo, vini pregiati e cucina stagionale nell'idilliaco cortile interno.

cards.img_alt: Liliane Pizzeria Café Gelateria, St. Paolo
cards.name: Liliane
cards.desc: Pizza dal forno a pietra, gelato fatto in casa e caffè tra mura medievali, informale, adatto alle famiglie, disponibile anche pizza con farro e senza glutine.
cards.hours: Gio–Dom fino alle 23:30, Lun–Mer fino alle 24:00 · Pizza dalle 17:00

cards.name: Pfeffermühle
cards.desc: Il punto d'incontro per i buongustai vicino a Bolzano: classici di tartare e cucina altoatesina moderna incontrano la pizza dal forno a legna, circondati da frutteti.
cards.hours: 11:45–14:00 & 18:00–21:30 · chiuso mercoledì tutto il giorno & giovedì a pranzo

cards.name: Platzegg
cards.desc: "Onesto, semplice, autentico": Herbert Hintner reinterpreta con stile da ristorante i classici altoatesini e piatti regionali quasi dimenticati, sulla piazza di San Michele.
cards.hours: Lun, Gio–Sab 12–14 & 18:30–21 · Mer 18:30–21 · Dom 12–14 · Mar chiuso

cards.name: Meraner (Talele)
cards.desc: Pizza dal forno a legna, classici alla griglia e cucina altoatesina in terza generazione, terrazza coperta ideale per l'aperitivo e le serate tiepide.
cards.hours: Mar–Sab 17–23 · Dom pizza 17–21 · Lun chiuso · in estate chiuso a pranzo

cards.name: Wiesenheim
cards.desc: Cucina mediterranea con specialità altoatesine e pizza dal forno a legna, in posizione tranquilla verso Frangarto, molto frequentato dagli abitanti del posto.
cards.hours: 12:00–14:00 & 17:30–21:15 (pizza fino alle 22) · domenica a pranzo solo pizza · giovedì chiuso

cards.name: The Grillhouse, Golfclub Appiano
cards.desc: Cucina mediterranea e succulente bistecche alla griglia a carbone direttamente sul campo da golf, cucina a vista, pizza dal forno a pietra e ampia carta dei vini in atmosfera rilassata.
cards.hours: Ristorante mar–sab 12–15 & 19–23 · Pizza mar–sab 17–23, dom 17–21

en.meta_title: Eating & drinking around Eppan | Hotel Weinberg
en.meta_description: Restaurant tips around St. Pauls, Eppan and Girlan: pizza, South Tyrolean cuisine and aperitivo – picked by the Schrott family of Hotel Weinberg.
en.hero_heading: Where to eat well around St. Pauls & Appiano
en.hero_text: We don't cook ourselves anymore, but we're happy to share where we go to eat: from the pizzeria around the corner to aperitivo in a historic manor.

polaroids.alt: Cocktail garnished with berries in the evening sun
polaroids.caption: Aperitivo hour

polaroids.alt: South Tyrolean dumplings with beef roast
polaroids.caption: Hearty & regional

cards.name: Paulserhof
cards.desc: A traditional inn with a 700-year-old wine cellar right in the village, South Tyrolean classics with a Mediterranean touch, a popular meeting spot for over 60 years.
cards.hours: Open year-round · reservation recommended

cards.name: Allegra
cards.desc: Mediterranean flair meets South Tyrolean tradition in a historic manor house, perfect for aperitivo, fine wines and seasonal cuisine in an idyllic inner courtyard.
cards.hours: Tue–Sat, 5pm–midnight

cards.img_alt: Liliane Pizzeria Café Ice Cream Parlour, St. Pauls
cards.name: Liliane
cards.desc: Stone-oven pizza, homemade ice cream and coffee behind medieval walls, relaxed, family-friendly, spelt and gluten-free pizza also available.
cards.hours: Thu–Sun until 11:30pm, Mon–Wed until midnight · pizza from 5pm

cards.name: Pfeffermühle
cards.desc: The meeting point for foodies near Bolzano: steak tartare classics and modern South Tyrolean cuisine meet wood-fired pizza, surrounded by orchards.
cards.hours: 11:45am–2pm & 6pm–9:30pm · closed all day Wed & Thu lunchtime

cards.name: Platzegg
cards.desc: "Honest, simple, authentic": Herbert Hintner turns South Tyrolean classics and nearly forgotten regional dishes into restaurant-worthy fare on the piazza of St. Michael.
cards.hours: Mon, Thu–Sat 12–2pm & 6:30–9pm · Wed 6:30–9pm · Sun 12–2pm · closed Tue

cards.name: Meraner (Talele)
cards.desc: Wood-fired pizza, grill classics and South Tyrolean cuisine, third-generation family tradition, a covered terrace ideal for aperitivo and mild evenings.
cards.hours: Tue–Sat 5–11pm · Sun pizza 5–9pm · closed Mon · closed at lunchtime in summer

cards.name: Wiesenheim
cards.desc: Mediterranean cuisine with South Tyrolean specialities and wood-fired pizza, in a quiet location towards Frangarto, a favourite with locals.
cards.hours: 12–2pm & 5:30–9:15pm (pizza until 10pm) · Sun lunch pizza only · closed Thu

cards.name: The Grillhouse, Golfclub Appiano
cards.desc: Mediterranean cuisine and juicy charcoal-grilled steaks right on the golf course, show kitchen, stone-oven pizza and a large wine selection in a relaxed atmosphere.
cards.hours: Restaurant Tue–Sat 12–3pm & 7–11pm · Pizza Tue–Sat 5–11pm, Sun 5–9pm
